title: 第3104章 王子被挟第3103章 格外刺耳
slug: 剑里乾坤第3107章不似作伪
content_zh:
叶鼎天仰头大笑，笑声如夜枭啼鸣，尖锐刺耳，在山谷间回荡不休：“卓然，你方才不是神勇无双吗？怎么如今连站都站不稳了？这副模样，还想护着谁？”
他挟持着四王子，缓缓退至崖边一块突出的岩石上，脚下便是万丈深渊，云雾翻涌如怒海，深不见底，偶有碎石坠落，许久听不到回响。他低头瞥了眼四王子涨红发紫的脸，又望向崖顶的卓然，嘴角浮起一抹猫戏老鼠般的阴冷笑意：
“卓然，咱们明人不说暗话。三枚龙钥，如今多半在你手中。我要你用这三枚钥匙，换这四王子的命！”
他顿了顿，五指又收紧三分，四王子顿时面色紫黑，喉间发出“咯咯”的窒息声响，眼中露出痛苦之色。“我给你一炷香的时间考虑。一炷香后，若不见钥匙，我便将这四王子推下万丈深渊，让他尸骨无存，连轮回的机会都没有！”
崖下众人哗然，个个面露愤懑却束手无策。水月心玉扇紧握，指节泛白，美眸中泪光与怒火交织，声音因愤怒而颤抖：“叶鼎天！你这般用无辜之人要挟，卑鄙无耻，算什么英雄好汉！”
“卑鄙？”叶鼎天冷笑一声，眼中满是不屑，“江湖之上，成王败寇，哪来那么多迂腐规矩？卓然，你选吧——是保这四王子的命，还是抱着那三枚钥匙，眼睁睁看着他死在你面前？”
卓然拄剑而立，面色苍白如纸，额头冷汗涔涔而下，顺着脸颊滑落，滴在染血的衣襟上。他望着被叶鼎天挟持的四王子，那双曾意气风发的眼睛此刻写满了痛苦与不甘；又低头看了眼手中红云白龙剑，剑身上赤银二色光芒黯淡，如风中残烛，映着他同样黯淡的眼神。
一炷香的时间，本如白驹过隙，此刻却漫长得让人窒息。每一秒流逝，都像一把重锤，敲在卓然的心上，也敲在崖下每一个人的心间。
崖顶之上，厉抗天与迦楼罗对视一眼，皆从对方眼中看到了一丝幸灾乐祸。厉抗天捂着肩头伤口，阴恻恻地笑道：叶宗主，好手段！这小子方才用剑里乾坤耗尽了内力，如今便是砧板上的鱼肉，任咱们宰割！
迦楼罗肋下伤口仍在渗血，却亦狞笑道：卓然，你方才的霸气呢？怎么如今连救个人都办不到？
卓然充耳不闻，只是死死盯着叶鼎天，眼中光芒明灭不定。
时间一分一秒地流逝，叶鼎天嘴角笑意愈发阴冷，五指缓缓收紧：卓然，时间快到了。你可想好了？
四王子被掐得面色青紫，却强撑着挤出一丝声音：卓……卓大哥……别……别管我……三枚钥匙……关乎武林命脉……绝不能……落入奸人之手……
闭嘴！叶鼎天厉喝一声，五指猛然收紧，四王子顿时双眼翻白，喉间发出的声响。
住手！卓然暴喝一声，声音嘶哑如裂帛，我给你！
他缓缓从怀中取出一块古朴的钥匙，钥匙上刻着繁复的纹路，隐隐有流光溢彩——正是三枚龙钥中的第一枚，长白秘钥。
叶鼎天眼中贪婪之色大盛，却又闪过一丝警惕：卓然，你当我是三岁孩童？先将三枚钥匙尽数交出，我再放人！
卓然嘴角浮起一抹苦笑，那笑容里带着几分无奈，几分狡黠，更有一种让人捉摸不透的从容。他摇了摇头，将玉佩在掌心轻轻掂了掂，阳光透过玉佩，在地上投下一道斑驳的光影。
叶宗主，你急什么？他声音虽虚弱，却字字清晰，三枚龙钥事关重大，我若全给了你，你翻脸不认人，我岂不是人财两空？
他顿了顿，目光扫过叶鼎天挟持四王子的手，又望向崖下众人，最后落在厉抗天与迦楼罗身上，嘴角笑意更深：况且，叶宗主与厉前辈、迦楼罗大师联手，三人围攻我一个内力耗尽之人，传出去，不怕江湖人耻笑？

叶鼎天眉头微皱，眼中闪过一丝不耐，却亦有几分自得。他冷笑道：卓然，你少来激将法。今日之事，成王败寇，谁会在意过程？
话虽如此，卓然缓缓将钥匙收回怀中，动作慢得让叶鼎天心头一紧，但叶宗主如果不讲信誉，我岂不是人财两空了？而且，你和厉抗天还有迦楼罗谈好怎么分配龙脉里面那海量的财宝了吗？
卓然还意味深长的看了一眼厉抗天和迦楼罗。
叶鼎天面色微变，厉声喝道：卓然！你休要挑拨离间！
挑拨离间？卓然轻笑一声，那笑声里带着几分讥讽，叶宗主，你与厉前辈、迦楼罗大师不过是临时结盟，各取所需。待三枚龙钥到手，龙脉开启，你们三人之间，难道就不会刀剑相向？
他顿了顿，声音愈发低沉，却如毒蛇吐信，字字钻心：你不会让别人忙活吧？还是准备杀人灭口……
他话未说完，却意味深长地望向厉抗天与迦楼罗。
崖顶之上，气氛骤然紧张。厉抗天与迦楼罗对视一眼，皆从对方眼中看到了一丝警惕与戒备。
叶宗主，厉抗天缓缓开口，声音沙哑如磨铁，这小子说的，可是真的？
叶鼎天面色铁青，厉声喝道：厉抗天！你莫要听他胡言乱语！
胡言乱语？卓然轻笑一声，厉前辈，你可知道，叶宗主为何独独要三枚龙钥，而不是与你们共享？
他顿了顿，声音如雷霆贯耳：因为三枚龙钥合一，方能开启龙脉入口。而入口开启之后，只有持钥者方能进入。叶宗主若独得三枚龙钥，你们二人……恐怕连龙脉的门都摸不着！
卓然！叶鼎天暴喝一声，眼中杀机大盛，你找死！
他五指猛然收紧，四王子顿时面色紫黑，双眼翻白，喉间发出的声响。
住手！卓然暴喝，声音嘶哑却带着一种破釜沉舟的决然，叶鼎天！你若杀了四王子，我保证你永远拿不到三枚龙钥！
叶鼎天手上动作一顿，眼中贪婪与杀意交织，如乱麻般纠缠不清。
content_en:
Ye Dingtian raised his head and laughed. The laughter was like the cry of a night owl, sharp and harsh, echoing endlessly in the valley: "Zhuoran, weren't you so brave just now? Why can't you even stand still now? Who else do you want to protect with this look?"
He held the fourth prince hostage and slowly retreated to a protruding rock on the edge of the cliff. At his feet was an abyss of ten thousand feet. The clouds and mist surged like an angry sea, and there was no bottom. Occasionally, gravel fell, and no echo was heard for a long time. He lowered his head and glanced at the red and purple face of the fourth prince, and then looked at Zhuoran on the top of the cliff. A sinister smile appeared on the corner of his mouth, like a cat playing with a mouse:
"Zhuoran, let's not talk secretly. The three dragon keys are probably in your hands now. I want you to use these three keys in exchange for the lives of the fourth prince!"
He paused and tightened his fingers by another three points. The fourth prince's face suddenly turned purple and black, a choking sound came from his throat, and there was a look of pain in his eyes. "I will give you one stick of incense to think about. After one stick of incense, if the key is not found, I will push the fourth prince down the abyss, leaving him with no bones left, and no chance of reincarnation!"
The people at the foot of the cliff were in an uproar, all looking angry but helpless. Shui Yuexin clenched her jade fan tightly, her knuckles turned white, tears and anger intertwined in her beautiful eyes, her voice trembled with anger: "Ye Dingtian! You threaten innocent people like this, you are despicable and shameless, how can you be a hero!"
"Despicable?" Ye Dingtian sneered, his eyes full of disdain, "On the rivers and lakes, there are winners and losers. How can there be so many pedantic rules? Zhuoran, you choose - save the life of the fourth prince, or hold the three keys and watch him die in front of you?"
Zhuo Ran stood with his sword in hand, his face as pale as paper, cold sweat dripping from his forehead, sliding down his cheeks and dripping on his blood-stained clothes. He looked at the fourth prince who was held hostage by Ye Dingtian, and his once-vigorous eyes were now full of pain and unwillingness; he then looked down at the red cloud and white dragon sword in his hand. The red and silver light on the sword was dim, like a candle in the wind, reflecting his equally dim eyes.
The time of a stick of incense should have passed by in vain, but now it is so long that it is suffocating. Every passing second is like a heavy hammer, hitting Zhuoran's heart and the hearts of everyone under the cliff.
On the top of the cliff, Li Kangtian and Garuda looked at each other, and both saw a hint of schadenfreude in each other's eyes. Li Kangtian covered the wound on his shoulder and smiled sadly: Sect Master Ye, what a trick! This kid has just exhausted his inner strength with the Qiankun in the sword, and now he is just a piece of fish on the chopping board, ready to be slaughtered by us!
The wound on Garuda's ribs was still oozing blood, but he smiled ferociously and said: Zhuoran, where was your domineering attitude just now? Why can't you even save someone now?
Zhuo Ran turned a deaf ear and just stared at Ye Dingtian, the light in his eyes flickering on and off.
Time passed by minute by second, and the smile on Ye Dingtian's mouth became colder and colder, and his fingers slowly tightened: Zhuoran, the time is almost up. Have you thought about it?
The fourth prince was pinched until his face turned purple, but he forced out a sound: Zhuo...Brother Zhuo...don't...leave me alone...the three keys...are related to the lifeblood of the martial arts world...must not...fall into the hands of evildoers...
Shut up! Ye Dingtian shouted sharply and tightened his fingers suddenly. The fourth prince's eyes suddenly turned white and there was a sound in his throat.
stop! Zhuo Ran shouted loudly, his voice as hoarse as cracked silk, I'll give it to you!
He slowly took out a simple key from his arms. The key was engraved with complex patterns and had a faint brilliance - it was the first of the three dragon keys, the Changbai Secret Key.
Ye Dingtian's eyes were filled with greed, but a hint of vigilance flashed through his eyes: Zhuoran, do you think I am a three-year-old child? Hand over all three keys first, and then I will let you go!
A bitter smile appeared on the corner of Zhuoran's mouth. There was a bit of helplessness, a bit of cunning, and an unpredictable calmness in that smile. He shook his head and gently weighed the jade pendant in his palm. The sunlight penetrated the jade pendant, casting a mottled light and shadow on the ground.
Sect Master Ye, what are you anxious about? Although his voice was weak, itThe words are clear. The three dragon keys are of great importance. If I give them all to you and you turn your back and deny me, won't I lose both my life and my wealth?
He paused and glanced at Ye Dingtian's hand holding the fourth prince, then looked at the people at the bottom of the cliff, and finally fell on Li Kangtian and Garuda. The smile on his lips deepened: Besides, Sect Master Ye joined forces with Senior Li and Master Garuda, and the three of them besieged me, a man who has exhausted his internal strength. If word spreads, are you not afraid of ridicule by people in the world?
Ye Dingtian frowned slightly, a trace of impatience flashed in his eyes, but he was also somewhat complacent. He sneered and said: Zhuoran, don't come here to provoke the general. Today's events will lead to victory and defeat. Who cares about the process?
Having said that, Zhuoran slowly took the key back into his arms. His movements were so slow that Ye Dingtian's heart tightened. But if Sect Master Ye doesn't keep his credibility, wouldn't I lose both my life and wealth? Moreover, have you, Li Kangtian and Garuda agreed on how to distribute the massive treasures in Dragon Vein?
Zhuoran also glanced meaningfully at Li Kangtian and Garuda.
Ye Dingtian's complexion changed slightly, and he shouted sharply: Zhuo Ran! Don't try to sow discord!
Sow discord? Zhuo Ran chuckled lightly, with a hint of sarcasm in the laughter, Sect Leader Ye, you, Senior Li and Master Garuda are just a temporary alliance, each getting what they need. When the three dragon keys are obtained and the dragon veins are opened, won't the three of you be at each other's swords?
He paused, and his voice became deeper and deeper, but like a poisonous snake spitting out a message, every word was heartbreaking: You won't let others do their work, right? Or are you prepared to kill people and silence them...
Before he finished speaking, he looked at Li Kangtian and Garuda meaningfully.
On the top of the cliff, the atmosphere suddenly became tense. Li Kangtian and Garuda looked at each other, and both saw a hint of vigilance and wariness in each other's eyes.
Sect Leader Ye, Li Kangtian spoke slowly, his voice hoarse as steel. Is what this kid said true?
Ye Dingtian's face was ashen and he shouted sternly: "Li Kangtian!" Don't listen to his nonsense!
nonsense? Zhuoran chuckled, "Senior Li, do you know why Sect Master Ye wants three dragon keys alone instead of sharing them with you?"
He paused, and his voice was like thunder: because the three dragon keys can be combined into one to open the entrance to the dragon vein. After the entrance is opened, only the key holder can enter. If Sect Leader Ye gets three Dragon Keys alone, you two... I'm afraid you won't even be able to touch the Dragon Veins' door!
Zhuoran! Ye Dingtian shouted violently, his eyes full of murderous intent, you are looking for death!
His fingers suddenly tightened, and the fourth prince suddenly turned purple and black, his eyes turned white, and there was a sound in his throat.
stop! Zhuo Ran shouted violently, his voice was hoarse but with a desperate determination, Ye Dingtian! If you kill the fourth prince, I guarantee you will never get the three dragon keys!
Ye Dingtian made a movement with his hands, greed and murderous intent intertwined in his eyes, tangled like a mess.
